description: Defines the ShippingSummary class used for representing shipping fee details in the sales management system, including shipping costs, handling fees, shipping module and option identifiers, and flags for free shipping and tax on shipping.

classes.name: ShippingSummary
classes.description: A JavaBean class encapsulating shipping cost details, including shipping amount, handling fee, shipping module, options, and related flags.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Checks if the shipping is free.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Checks if tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: setTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Sets whether tax applies on shipping.
